goal: Record feature capabilities of the last client opening or decrypting a wallet
Allow future releases to safely detect downgrades and rerun upgrades without expensive wallet rescans
agreement: Broad support across multiple iterations with several ACKs (ajtowns, Bortlesboat, Eunovo, w0xlt)
Concept approval to help detect mixed old and new data across versions (ryanofsky)
Nonblocking objection: migration and unlock ignore feature write return values (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it provides foundational metadata needed for future automated wallet upgrades
Prevents costly full-wallet rescans on load when detecting mixed-version data after downgrades
